translations.web: He will guide the humble in justice. He will teach the humble his way.
translations.bsb: He guides the humble in what is right and teaches them His way.
translations.kjv: The meek will he guide in judgment: and the meek will he teach his way.
translations.asv: The meek will he guide in justice; And the meek will he teach his way.
